description_en: Queries a list of tasks in the task center
description_zh: 查看任务中心的任务列表
name: DescribeHistoryTasks

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 待处理事件所属的地域ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html查询
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，取值：10~100。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 查询结果的页码。取值范围：正整数。 默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The task status. Valid values:

Scheduled
Running
Succeed
Failed
Cancelling
Canceled
Waiting

This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that tasks in all states are queried. Separate multiple states with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态，用于选择对应状态的任务：
Scheduled：等待执行
Running：执行中
Succeed：执行成功
Failed：执行失败
Cancelling：正在终止
Canceled：已终止
Waiting：等待预设时间
默认为空，表示全选，如需选择多个状态请用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that you can specify an unlimited number of instance IDs. Separate multiple instance IDs with commas (,). You can specify up to 30 instance IDs
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID，用于查询对应实例的任务，默认为空，表示不限制。如需查询多个实例请用英文逗号（,）分隔，最多支持30个
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The task ID. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that you can specify an unlimited number of task IDs. Separate multiple task IDs with commas (,). You can specify up to 30 task IDs
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID，用于查询已知ID的任务默认为空，表示不限制。如需查询多个请用英文逗号（,）分隔，最多支持30个
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
The task type. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that you can specify an unlimited number of task types.

ModifyInsSpec
DeleteInsNode
AddInsNode
HaSwitch
RestartIns
CreateIns
ModifyInsConfig

Separate multiple task types with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
任务类型，用于查询特定类型任务情况，默认为空，表示不限制，取值如下：
ModifyInsSpec：规格变更或迁移
DeleteInsNode：删除分片
AddInsNode：增加分片
HaSwitch：实例主备切换
RestartIns：重启实例
CreateIns：创建实例
ModifyInsConfig：配置变更
如需查询多个请用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. The start time can be up to 30 days earlier than the current time
parameters.help_zh: 查询任务的最早开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间），最早支持查询30天前的数据
parameters.name: from_start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. Only tasks that have a start time earlier than or equal to the time specified by this parameter are queried
parameters.help_zh: 查询任务的最晚开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间），需晚于任务的最早开始时间
parameters.name: to_start_time

parameters.help_en: The minimum execution duration of a task. This parameter is used to filter tasks whose execution duration is longer than the minimum execution duration. Unit: seconds. The default value is 0, which indicates that no limit is imposed
parameters.help_zh: 任务执行耗时的最小值。用于筛选任务执行耗时大于此时间的任务，单位秒。默认0，表示不限制
parameters.name: from_exec_time

parameters.help_en: The maximum execution duration of a task. This parameter is used to filter tasks whose execution duration is shorter than or equal to the maximum execution duration. Unit: seconds. The default value is 0, which indicates that no limit is imposed
parameters.help_zh: 任务执行耗时的最大值。用于筛选任务执行耗时不小于此时间的任务，单位秒。默认0，表示不限制
parameters.name: to_exec_time

CallerSource.description_en: The ID of the user who made the request. If CallerSource is set to User, CallerUid indicates the unique ID (UID) of the user
CallerSource.description_zh: 请求用户ID，callerSource为User时代表用户UID

CallerUid.description_en:
The request source. Valid values:

System
User
CallerUid.description_zh:
请求来源。 
System：系统自动
User：用户

CurrentStepName.description_en: The name of the current step. If this parameter is left empty, the task is not started
CurrentStepName.description_zh: 当前执行的步骤名，如果为空代表任务未开始

DbType.description_en: The database type. The return value is redis

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the task. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
EndTime.description_zh: 任务结束时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

InstanceType.description_en: The instance type. The return value is Instance

Product.description_en: The product. The return value is kvstore

Progress.description_en: The task progress. Valid values: 0 to 100

ReasonCode.description_en: The reason why the current task was initiated

RemainTime.description_en: The estimated amount of time remaining to complete the task. Unit: seconds. A value of 0 indicates that the task is completed
RemainTime.description_zh: 预估剩余执行时间，单位秒，0表示已执行完成

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the task. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 任务开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

Status.description_en:
The task status.

Scheduled
Running
Succeed
Failed
Cancelling
Canceled
Waiting
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。
Scheduled：等待执行
Running：执行中
Succeed：执行成功
Failed：执行失败
Cancelling：正在终止
Canceled：已终止
Waiting：等待预设时间

TaskDetail.description_en: The task details. The details vary based on the task type
TaskDetail.description_zh: 任务详情，不同taskType对应不同的输出

TaskType.description_en:
The task type.

ModifyInsSpec
DeleteInsNode
AddInsNode
HaSwitch
RestartIns
CreateIns
ModifyInsConfig
TaskType.description_zh:
任务类型。
ModifyInsSpec：规格变更或迁移
DeleteInsNode：删除分片
AddInsNode：增加分片
HaSwitch：实例主备切换
RestartIns：重启实例
CreateIns：创建实例
ModifyInsConfig：配置变更

Uid.description_en: The ID of the user to which the resources belong

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 每页显示的最大记录数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of tasks that meet these constraints without taking pagination into account
TotalCount.description_zh: 不考虑分页因素，满足查询条件的总任务数
